setup.title: Set up rwnd.tv
setup.description: Create the admin account for this instance.
setup.emailRequiredBody: This instance can't be set up until SMTP is configured, so the admin account's email address can be verified like any other. Set the SMTP_* environment variables, then reload this page.

history.empty: You haven't logged anything yet. Search for something you've watched to get started.

import.title: Import
import.notConfigured: Connecting a Trakt account isn't set up on this instance — the admin needs to set TRAKT_CLIENT_ID and TRAKT_CLIENT_SECRET. You can still import from a Trakt export file or an rwnd.tv export file below.

trakt.description: Connect a Trakt account to import your watch history, ratings, and watchlist.
trakt.pairingInstructions: Enter this code at the link below to authorise rwnd.tv:
trakt.denied: Pairing was denied on Trakt. You can try again.
trakt.expired: This code expired before it was used. You can try again.

zip.title: Import from a Trakt export file
zip.description: On trakt.tv, go to Settings → Data → "Export now" to download a ZIP of your data, then upload it here.
zip.invalidType: Please choose the .zip file Trakt's "Export now" downloaded.
zip.startDescription: Choose what to bring in from the file. Re-running an import is safe — it won't create duplicates.

csv.title: Import from an rwnd.tv export file
csv.description: Upload a data export downloaded from Settings → Database → Export data (this instance or another one) to bring its watch history, ratings, watchlist, and dropped TV shows in here.
csv.invalidType: Please choose the .zip file downloaded from Export data.
csv.startDescription: Choose what to bring in from the file. Re-running an import is safe — it won't create duplicates.

start.title: Start an import
start.description: Choose what to bring in from Trakt. Re-running an import is safe — it won't create duplicates.
start.alreadyRunning: An import is already in progress.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.description: Use API tokens to let other apps (like Plex scrobblers) log watches on your behalf.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.createdOnce: Copy this token now — it won't be shown again.

plex.title: Connect Plex
plex.description: Paste this URL into your Plex server's Settings → Webhooks (requires Plex Pass). Watches will start logging automatically.

database.title: Database
database.description: Permanently delete your own tracked data. This can't be undone.
database.confirmTitle: Are you sure you want to clear the following from the database?

backup.title: Backups
backup.description: Save a copy of your watch history, ratings, watchlists, and dropped TV shows, so you can restore it later.
backup.skipped_one: {{count}} item couldn't be included (no matching TMDB entry)
backup.skipped_other: {{count}} items couldn't be included (no matching TMDB entry)
backup.confirmRestoreTitle: Are you sure you want to restore this backup?
backup.confirmRestoreBody: This replaces your current watch history, ratings, watchlists, and dropped TV shows with "{{description}}" ({{date}}). This can't be undone.
backup.confirmDeleteTitle: Are you sure you want to delete this backup?
backup.confirmDeleteBody: This permanently deletes "{{description}}" ({{date}}). This can't be undone.

export.title: Export data
export.description: Download your watch history, ratings, watchlist, and dropped TV shows as CSV files — an open format you can open in a spreadsheet or take to another tool.
export.importLink: To bring this into another rwnd.tv instance, use Import.

instance.title: Instance settings
instance.environmentLabel: This instance is labelled "{{label}}", set via the ENVIRONMENT_LABEL environment variable — not editable here.
instance.metadataProvidersSingle: Only one provider is configured on this instance.

account.title: Account
account.changeEmailSuccess: Verification email sent to {{email}} — click the link there to confirm the change.
account.avatarInvalidType: Unsupported image type — use JPEG, PNG, or WebP.
account.spoilerProtectionDescription: Blurs episode stills, titles, and overviews you haven't watched yet, and show/season descriptions until fully watched. Click any blurred item to reveal it just for that view.
account.onDeckFillGapsDescription: Continue Watching normally only shows the episode right after the latest one you've watched. Turn this on to also surface an earlier episode you skipped.
account.deleteWarning: Permanently delete your account and everything in it — watch history, ratings, watchlist, dropped shows, API tokens, and any connected services. This can't be undone.
account.deleteConfirmBody: This will permanently delete your account and everything in it. This can't be undone. To confirm, type your email address ({{email}}) and current password below.
account.deleteAdminBlocked: Admin accounts can't be deleted yet.
